free_tier_limits.correction: Free: get_memes + caption_image (watermarked) with fair-use rate limiting; not documented as unlimited. Premium ($9.99/mo) adds included Premium request allotments then per-request fees for GIF/search/AI/no-watermark (exact allotments on docs).

description.correction: Imgflip's RESTful JSON API lists popular meme templates and captions them into shareable images. Free tier supports get_memes and caption_image (with watermark); Premium ($9.99/mo) unlocks GIF captioning, full meme search, AI generation, and watermark removal. Auth uses Imgflip username/password form fields—no API key header. Free usage is fair-use rate-limited rather than documented as unlimited.

notes: Docs confirm base URL, auth via username/password form fields, free get_memes/caption_image with watermark, Premium $9.99/mo for advanced features. Entry overstates free tier as "unlimited"; docs emphasize fair use and possible rate limiting. CORS not documented (unknown is correct).
